response.sql: WITH state_accts AS (SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(c.state_county_province), ''), 'NO_STATE') AS state, COUNT(a.account_id) AS account_base FROM Customers c LEFT JOIN Accounts a ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY 1), shares AS (SELECT state, account_base, account_base * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(account_base) OVER (), 0) AS share FROM state_accts), mean_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM shares), above AS (SELECT s.account_base, s.share FROM shares s WHERE s.share > (SELECT avg_share FROM mean_share)) SELECT SUM(account_base) AS combined_account_base, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - (SELECT avg_share FROM mean_share)) AS avg_excess_over_mean FROM above;
